macros.name: igrboxcenter
macros.doc: The current content of the \igrbox is put in the center of a separate page which has the current pdfpage dimensions.

macros.name: igrboxset
macros.doc: The ⟨text⟩ is put into a TeX box named \igrbox.

macros.name: igrboxtikz
macros.doc: The current content of the \igrbox is embedded into a \node command from the tikz package [4] which has to be loaded separately.

macros.name: igrboxtikzcenter
macros.doc: The current content of the \igrbox is embedded into a \node command from the tikz package [4] which has to be loaded separately. This node is placed in the center of a bounding box which takes the current page dimensions.

macros.name: igrcenter
macros.doc: The ⟨text⟩ is put in the center of a separate page which has the current document dimensions.

macros.name: igrcenterfit
macros.doc: The ⟨text⟩ is put in the center of a separate page which is resized to the given ⟨width⟩ and ⟨height⟩.

macros.name: igrGetLastPage
macros.doc: After calling \igrGetLastPage, the macro \igrLastPage contains the page count of the currently processed file.

macros.name: igrifmatch
macros.doc: If a ⟨key⟩ was defined by \igrsetmatchvalue or \igrsetmatches, the corresponding value is put in the macro \igrmatchvalue and the ⟨then⟩ code is executed. If the ⟨key⟩ is unknown, the ⟨else⟩ code is executed.

macros.name: igrLastPage
macros.doc: The page count of the PDF file is available as \last or alternatively \igrLastPage.

macros.name: igrmakezerofill
macros.doc: With this command, a new ⟨macro⟩ can be defined which takes a non negative number as parameter. This number is filled up with leading zeros until the ⟨digits⟩ count is reached.

macros.name: igrpage
macros.doc: The ⟨text⟩ is put on a separate page which is resized to fit the dimensions of the ⟨text⟩.

macros.name: igrPageHeight
macros.doc: After using \igrGetPageSize, \igrPageHeight contains the current page height.

macros.name: igrpagestyle
macros.doc: The style of the separate page is set to the content of the macro \igrpagestyle which defaults to ’empty’ but can be redefined.

macros.name: igrPageWidth
macros.doc: After using \igrGetPageSize, \igrPageWidth contains the current page width.

macros.name: igrsetmatchvalue
macros.doc: The given ⟨key⟩ is mapped to the given ⟨value⟩.

macros.name: igrSetPageSize
macros.doc: Sets the current page dimensions to ⟨width⟩ and ⟨height⟩.

macros.name: igrtargetset
macros.doc: The next value for \igrAutoTarget is set to ⟨anchor⟩. This can be used for hand-made hyperlinks or bookmarks.

macros.name: incgraph
macros.doc: The picture file with the given ⟨file name⟩ is included in the center of a separate page.

macros.name: incmultigraph
macros.doc: All picture files matching the given ⟨file name pattern⟩ where some parts are substituted by elements of the ⟨list⟩ are included in the center of separate pages.

macros.name: last
macros.doc: The page count of the PDF file is available as \last or alternatively \igrLastPage.

macros.name: nn
macros.doc:
The elements of the list can be used inside the ⟨file name pattern⟩ with the following macros: • 
: The current element of the list (may be a number). • 
i: The position of the current element inside the list, i. e. 
i counts from 1 to the size of the list. • 
n: The zero-filled 
, if 
 is a number.

envs.name: inctext
envs.doc: The environment content is included in the center of a separate page.
